prose:
A Reuters item indexed by Techmeme reports Dell's third-quarter revenue rising 103% year over year to $54.94 billion, above a $49.32 billion estimate. It says Dell raised annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year amid strong AI-server demand.

The Reuters page returned an access error, so this summary is limited to the feed excerpt. The full earnings release, accounting measures, margins, backlog and forecast assumptions were not inspected. Revenue growth and raised guidance do not by themselves establish profitability of every AI-server order or guarantee future demand.
highlights: Guidance increase is described as the third this year
Full Reuters and earnings context were inaccessible
Revenue and guidance are not guaranteed future profits
